## 🧪 Flaky unit test detection

### Run history flaky detection

[View recent run history](https://github.com/MetaMask/metamask-mobile/actions/workflows/ci.yml?query=branch%3Amain)

Historical failure rate is a hint, not proof — review each suggestion in context. See the [flaky-test-detection skill](https://github.com/MetaMask/skills/blob/main/domains/coding/skills/flaky-test-detection/skill.md) for the full pattern reference and manual audit workflow.

Failures / runs sampled per window:

| File | 7d | 15d | 30d |
|---|---|---|---|
| `app/components/UI/Perps/Views/PerpsMarketListView/PerpsMarketListView.test.tsx` | 0/145 | 0/229 | 0/431 |
| `app/components/UI/Perps/Views/PerpsModeSelectionView/PerpsModeSelectionView.test.tsx` | 0/145 | 0/229 | 0/431 |
| `app/components/UI/Perps/hooks/usePerpsProMarketHeaderActions.test.ts` | 0/145 | 0/229 | 0/431 |
| `app/components/UI/Perps/utils/perpsModeSwitch.test.ts` | 0/145 | 0/229 | 0/431 |


### AI-detected flaky patterns

#### `app/components/UI/Perps/Views/PerpsMarketListView/PerpsMarketListView.test.tsx`

- **J4 — `waitFor` without a real assertion inside** (high)
  - The `waitFor` function is resolving immediately without any assertions inside, which can lead to race conditions where the subsequent assertions may fail due to asynchronous updates not being completed.
  - Suggested fix in [`app/components/UI/Perps/Views/PerpsMarketListView/PerpsMarketListView.test.tsx:123`](https://github.com/MetaMask/metamask-mobile/blob/44514f37ccdbf4ce037a8f353aa4b36b6dd84fc8/app/components/UI/Perps/Views/PerpsMarketListView/PerpsMarketListView.test.tsx#L123):
    ```diff
    -await waitFor(() => {});
    +await waitFor(() => {
    +  expect(screen.getByTestId('market-row-BTC')).toBeOnTheScreen();
    +});
    ```

#### `app/components/UI/Perps/Views/PerpsModeSelectionView/PerpsModeSelectionView.test.tsx`

- **J4 — `waitFor` without a real assertion inside** (high)
  - The use of `await Promise.resolve();` does not contain a real assertion inside a `waitFor`, which can lead to race conditions and flaky tests as it resolves immediately without waiting for any specific condition to be met.
  - Suggested fix in [`app/components/UI/Perps/Views/PerpsModeSelectionView/PerpsModeSelectionView.test.tsx:1`](https://github.com/MetaMask/metamask-mobile/blob/44514f37ccdbf4ce037a8f353aa4b36b6dd84fc8/app/components/UI/Perps/Views/PerpsModeSelectionView/PerpsModeSelectionView.test.tsx#L1):
    ```diff
    -await Promise.resolve();
    +await waitFor(() => {
    +  expect(mockSetMode).toHaveBeenCalledWith(PerpsMode.Lite);
    +});
    ```

#### `app/components/UI/Perps/hooks/usePerpsProMarketHeaderActions.test.ts`

- **J4 — `waitFor` without a real assertion inside** (high)
  - The use of `await act(async () => {...});` does not contain a real assertion inside a `waitFor`, which can lead to race conditions and flaky tests as it resolves immediately without waiting for any specific condition to be met.
  - Suggested fix in [`app/components/UI/Perps/hooks/usePerpsProMarketHeaderActions.test.ts:1`](https://github.com/MetaMask/metamask-mobile/blob/44514f37ccdbf4ce037a8f353aa4b36b6dd84fc8/app/components/UI/Perps/hooks/usePerpsProMarketHeaderActions.test.ts#L1):
    ```diff
    -await act(async () => {
    -      applied = await result.current.handlePerpsModeChange(PerpsMode.Lite);
    -    });
    +await waitFor(() => {
    +  expect(applied).toBe(true);
    +});
    ```

#### `app/components/UI/Perps/utils/perpsModeSwitch.test.ts`

- **J3 — Missing `jest.clearAllMocks()` / `jest.resetAllMocks()`** (high)
  - The test setup does not clear or reset mocks between tests, which can lead to shared state between tests causing intermittent failures.
  - Suggested fix in [`app/components/UI/Perps/utils/perpsModeSwitch.test.ts:10`](https://github.com/MetaMask/metamask-mobile/blob/44514f37ccdbf4ce037a8f353aa4b36b6dd84fc8/app/components/UI/Perps/utils/perpsModeSwitch.test.ts#L10):
    ```diff
    -beforeEach(() => {
    -  // No clear/reset mocks
    -});
    +beforeEach(() => {
    +  jest.clearAllMocks();
    +  jest.resetAllMocks();
    +});
    ```


_This check is informational only and does not block merging._

Flaky-test detection triage — all three findings are **FALSE POSITIVE**.

The J9 pattern is "module-level mutable `let` bindings **not reset in `beforeEach`**". All three flagged variables are already reset in `beforeEach`, so the precondition for the pattern does not hold:

```js
beforeEach(() => {
  jest.clearAllMocks();
  mockCanGoBack = true;        // finding 1
  mockPerpsStackIndex = 1;     // finding 2
  mockIsWatchlist = false;     // finding 3
  mockPerpsModeValue = PerpsMode.Pro;
  mockOpenPerpsModeSelectionIfNeeded.mockResolvedValue(false);
});
```

The declaration initializers (`let mockCanGoBack = true;`) are defaults, not the reset mechanism. Applying the suggested diffs would add a second `beforeEach` that duplicates the existing one.

Order-independence verified empirically — 7 execution orders, all green:

| Order | Result |
|---|---|
| default | 15/15 passed |
| `--randomize --seed=1` | 15/15 passed |
| `--randomize --seed=7` | 15/15 passed |
| `--randomize --seed=99` | 15/15 passed |
| `--randomize --seed=424242` | 15/15 passed |
| `--randomize --seed=12345` | 15/15 passed |
| `--randomize --seed=8888` | 15/15 passed |

Consistent with the run-history sample in the report itself (0/112, 0/252, 0/433).

No code change required.

Flaky-test detection triage (comment updated after the earlier J9 findings):

- J4 (`PerpsModeSelectionView.test.tsx`): FALSE POSITIVE. The file has no `waitFor`. The cited snippet is `await Promise.resolve()` after an async `handleSelect`, not a waitFor-without-assertion.

- J6 (same `Promise.resolve()`): FALSE POSITIVE. `handleSelect` awaits `markPerpsModeSelectionCompleted()`, which the test mocks as an immediately resolving promise. One microtask flush is not `setTimeout`/`sleep`. Assertions follow the flush. `requestAnimationFrame` is mocked to run inline.

- J3 (`perpsModeSwitch.test.ts`): FALSE POSITIVE. `jest.clearAllMocks()` is the right reset here. `jest.resetAllMocks()` would wipe selector default implementations (`selectPerpsLastViewedMarketSymbol` returns `'BTC'`) and per-test `useSelector` implementations.

Run-history sample in the report is 0/145, 0/269, 0/489. No code change.

Bugbot "Unstamped Home drop skips fallback" was already fixed in `3d9351e` (now `7690b91` after rebase onto main) and the review thread is resolved.

## 🔍 Smart E2E Test Selection
- **Selected E2E tags**: SmokePerps, SmokeWalletPlatform, SmokeConfirmations
- **Selected Performance tags**: @PerformancePreps
- **Risk Level**: medium
- **AI Confidence**: 88%

<details>
<summary>click to see 🤖 AI reasoning details</summary>

**E2E Test Selection:**
All 9 changed files are within the Perps feature area (app/components/UI/Perps/). The changes fix a navigation bug (TAT-3786) where switching from Lite to Pro mode in Perps would incorrectly navigate the user to the wallet instead of staying in Perps. 

Key changes:
1. New utility functions in perpsModeSwitch.ts: `withHomeDroppedFromHistory`, `wasPerpsHomeDroppedFromHistory`, `preserveHomeDroppedFromHistory` - these stamp route params to distinguish between "single-entry Perps stack from Explore" vs "Lite→Pro mode switch that dropped Home"
2. PerpsHomeView.tsx and PerpsModeSelectionView.tsx use `withHomeDroppedFromHistory` when navigating to market details
3. PerpsMarketListView.tsx uses `preserveHomeDroppedFromHistory` to propagate the stamp when the market picker replaces a route
4. usePerpsMarketHeaderActions.ts updated back press handler to check `wasPerpsHomeDroppedFromHistory` to correctly route back navigation

The changes affect Perps navigation flows (back button behavior, mode switching), which directly maps to SmokePerps. Per the tag descriptions:
- SmokePerps requires also selecting SmokeWalletPlatform (Perps is a section inside Trending tab) and SmokeConfirmations (Add Funds deposits are on-chain transactions)

The test files are unit tests only and don't affect E2E tag selection directly. The functional changes are medium risk - they fix a navigation bug in a specific flow (Lite→Pro mode switch back navigation) without touching core infrastructure.

**Performance Test Selection:**
The changes affect Perps navigation flows including market details navigation and mode switching. The @PerformancePreps tag covers perps market loading, position management, add funds flow, and order execution. The navigation changes in PerpsHomeView, PerpsMarketListView, and PerpsModeSelectionView could potentially affect the measured performance of the perps flow, particularly the market loading and navigation transitions. However, the changes are primarily bug fixes to back-navigation logic and route parameter stamping, which are unlikely to significantly impact render times. Including @PerformancePreps as a conservative measure to validate the perps flow still performs within acceptable bounds after the navigation changes.

</details>

**Should-fix** (`app/components/UI/Perps/types/navigation.ts`)

`homeDroppedFromHistory` is not on `PerpsMarketDetails` (or the other routes this PR stamps). Extra params will keep compiling, which is how Home→Pro resets and the header picker replace already dropped the stamp.

Please add the flag to `PerpsStackParamList` (at least `PerpsMarketDetails`, and any other route `dropPerpsHomeFromStackHistory` / `withHomeDroppedFromHistory` writes) so new resets and pushes cannot omit it silently.
